title: correction_cycles decoder is the only RC4.3 additive key without null tolerance; a null value fails the whole application-detail decode
finding: The seven RC4.3 string keys (taken_over_at, contact_name/email/phone, corrected_name/email/phone) all decode via decode.optional(decode.string), so both absence AND explicit null yield None. correction_cycles is the sole exception: decode.optional_field("correction_cycles", 0, decode.int) (lines 608-611) only defaults on key ABSENCE — a present-but-null value runs decode.int against JSON null, which errors (verified against the installed gleam_stdlib optional_field: Ok(Some(data)) -> field_decoder.function(data)). Because the client decodes reference_calls as decode.list(detail_decoder()) inside the whole application-detail payload (application_api.gleam fetch_application_detail), one null correction_cycles fails the ENTIRE detail payload — the whole detail page errors, not just the row — unlike every sibling key in the same hunk, which tolerate null and degrade gracefully. No current producer can emit null (server field is typed Int and the column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 since rc2-1; pre-RC4.3 servers omit the key entirely, which the default 0 handles), so this is not reachable from today's servers — but it is the one boundary the new decoder does not account for, and the blast radius (whole-payload failure) is disproportionate to the missing guard (decode.optional(decode.int) with a None-then-default mapping, or keeping the sibling pattern).
evidence: shared/src/shared/reference_call.gleam:608-611 decode.optional_field("correction_cycles", 0, decode.int) vs lines 573-606 where all sibling keys use decode.optional(decode.string); encoder at line 536 emits json.int(detail.correction_cycles) so the server side is null-free; client decodes the full payload at client/src/api/application_api.gleam:42-55 via decode.list(application_detail.decoder()) -> decode.list(reference_call.detail_decoder()); reference_call table defines correction_cycles INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (supabase/migrations/20260731222000_create_reference_call.sql:102).
path: A wire payload carrying "correction_cycles": null (malformed proxy, hand-crafted response, or a future server emitting null for a nullable variant) is not guarded and fails the whole application-detail decode with no row-level or partial degradation.
